entry.title: OpenAI Says a Secret AI Model Cracked Hundreds of Open Math Problems in One Prompt—Mathematicians Want Receipts
entry.summary: OpenAI posted 722 AI-written math manuscripts from an unreleased model, saying most came from a single prompt. Some mathematicians call the claims unverified.

entry.title: Ethereum Researcher Says AI May Break Encryption Before Quantum Does
entry.summary: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake urged holders to calmly move funds to unused addresses, warning that AI-driven math could break crypto signatures before quantum computers do.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches Haiku 5.5: Its Cheapest and Fastest Claude Model Yet
entry.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs about 75% less to run than its predecessor and targets high-volume jobs like summaries and live customer support. It arrives 15 days after Opus 5.5.

entry.title: SEC and CFTC Crypto Rules 'Fall Short' of Clarity, Says Rep. French Hill
entry.summary: The House Financial Services chairman credited the SEC and CFTC for stepping in after the Clarity Act's collapse but said only "permanent law change" can secure U.S. leadership.

entry.title: Tether Signs Deal With Kazakhstan's Central Bank to Explore a Stablecoin and Tokenized Assets
entry.summary: Tether, issuer of the USDT stablecoin, will help Kazakhstan's central bank study a tenge-pegged token and put real-world assets on a blockchain.

entry.title: Hackers Used AI Agents to Raid a Megachurch's Database, Exposing 850,000 Members
entry.summary: Seoul's Yoido Full Gospel Church says data on 850,000 members may be compromised, and a security firm found signs AI helped run the attack.

entry.title: Google Lets You Build a Video Game by Typing a Description
entry.summary: Google's Playground turns a typed description into a playable, shareable game, no coding required. It's live for U.S. adults, with creation access tiered by Google AI subscription.

entry.title: US Government Moves $103 Million in Seized Bitcoin and BNB, But Hasn't Said Why
entry.summary: Government-labeled wallets sent 833.6 BTC to Coinbase Prime deposit addresses and shuffled 40,285 BNB. No sale is confirmed, but the stash behind it is the largest any government holds in Arkham's ranking.

entry.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $83K as Oil Shock Rattles Markets: What Happens Next?
entry.summary: Bitcoin fell sharply as oil topped $101 and the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2002. The daily chart still leans bullish. The four-hour chart disagrees.

entry.title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
entry.summary: Speaking at Token2049 in Singapore, the chairman said Bitmine is about 100,000 ETH—roughly six to seven weeks—from its 5% cap, setting an end date on a buying spree that made it the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

entry.title: Engineer Gets 32 Months for Bitcoin Extortion Plot Against His Own Employer
entry.summary: Daniel Rhyne locked his company's IT administrators out of its network and demanded 20 BTC, then worth $750,000, to stop the shutdowns.

entry.title: Morning Minute: OKX Raises at $25B From Circle, Ripple, and StanChart
entry.summary: OKX raises more, $500M+ in crypto longs liquidated after a late evening selloff, and Abstract calls it quits.

entry.title: Europol Warns Crypto Wallets Are 'Primary Risk' for Quantum Attacks
entry.summary: The EU police agency expects blockchains to adapt to the threat, while a second report weighs the risk of data stolen now and cracked later.

entry.title: Prosecutors Cite Bitcoin Fog Ruling Against Roman Storm's Venue Challenge
entry.summary: The Tornado Cash founder hit back in a tweet, noting FinCEN withdrew a proposed mixer rule over concerns it could chill legitimate activity.

entry.title: Ledger Launches Bitcoin Loans, Letting Holders Borrow Without Selling
entry.summary: Unveiled at TOKEN2049 Singapore, the Morpho-powered Crypto Loan feature lets users borrow stablecoins against wrapped Bitcoin while keeping private keys and final approval on their hardware device.

entry.title: Google Launches Nano Banana 2.1: Better Than Its Predecessor at Half the Price
entry.summary: Google's new image model, Nano Banana 2.1, is live. It costs about half as much as its predecessor, but the performance claims come from Google's own tests.

entry.title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
entry.summary: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.

entry.title: Someone Scraped 5.6 Billion TikTok Videos and Put the Data on Hugging Face for Free
entry.summary: A developer posted metadata for about 5.6 billion public TikTok videos, scraped through the app's private API in a way TikTok's terms prohibit. The free dataset also doubles as a storefront.

entry.title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
entry.summary: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

entry.title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
entry.summary: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.

entry.title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
entry.summary: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

entry.title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
entry.summary: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under "WINK" with Gemini as custodian, and add the Winklevoss twins to a wave of institutional interest in the privacy coin.

entry.title: Mistral AI Drops 'Le Chonk': A Massive AI Model Named After a Cat Meme
entry.summary: Paris-based Mistral launched Large 4, a model nicknamed after a June internet joke. It tops GPT-6 Astra on one finance test, but trails Claude on others.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Asleep, But Privacy Coins Zcash and Monero Are Waking Up
entry.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum barely moved today, but Zcash and Monero are leading the largest coins over the last 24 hours.

entry.title: Flash Loan Attacks Drained $1.2B From DeFi Between 2020 and 2024: Study
entry.summary: Attacks grew more sophisticated and less predictable over the period, according to researchers who scanned more than 20 billion transactions.

entry.title: Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered Back OKX at Flat $25B Valuation
entry.summary: A London quantitative hedge fund joins the round too, seven months after the NYSE's owner bought in at exactly the same price.

entry.title: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges
entry.summary: Clear rules of the road are here. So what does it all mean and what is the overall impact?

entry.title: Don Davis Bill Would Fine Candidates $10K for Trading on Their Own Elections
entry.summary: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act also gives prediction markets cover to close accounts and report candidates to regulators.

entry.title: Crypto 'Godfather' Gets Six Years for Hiring Sheriff's Deputies, $37M Meta Fraud
entry.summary: Adam Iza used off-duty LA deputies to pull warrants and personal data on his rivals, then moved the proceeds through crypto custodians.

entry.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
entry.summary: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

entry.title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
entry.summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

entry.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
entry.summary: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

entry.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
entry.summary: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.

entry.title: Why a 4chan Bitcoin Prophecy Says Today Is the End of Crypto Winter
entry.summary: An anonymous 4chan user called Bitcoin's October 2025 peak to the day way back in 2023. Could they be right again?

entry.title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
entry.summary: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.

entry.title: Crypto Sleuth ZachXBT Fronted $350K to Pose as a Client of Lazarus' Chinese Launderers
entry.summary: The on-chain sleuth says he posed as a customer of a Chinese crime syndicate, fronting $349,700 and eating 5% on every order, to track Lazarus Group's Bybit loot in real time.

entry.title: SEC Clears 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds for Trading
entry.summary: The agency approved a Cboe rule letting six Volatility Shares funds that triple the daily moves of Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, oil, and natural gas list on a U.S. exchange.
